_comment: The Basalt extension store feed. The published copy lives at https://github.com/closedsrc/basalt-extensions — paste https://raw.githubusercontent.com/closedsrc/basalt-extensions/main/feed.json into Settings -> Extensions -> Discover. Each `url` points at a .basaltext uploaded to a GitHub Release. This in-repo copy is the authoring source; keep it in sync with the hosted one when publishing updates.

extensions.name: Servers
extensions.author: Basalt
extensions.description: Host Minecraft servers locally. Create Vanilla, Paper, Fabric or Forge servers, run them with a live two-way console, edit server.properties, and manage their files.

extensions.name: Basaltify
extensions.author: Basalt
extensions.description: A music player for the launcher. Searches and streams from YouTube via yt-dlp, with a trending chart, local playlists, and a now-playing bar that keeps playing as you browse.
